title: Settings
dyslexiaHelp: Uses OpenDyslexic, a font with heavier letter bottoms that some readers find easier.
lowDataHelp: For slow internet: no maps or animations, fewer results, and the AI only runs when you tap search.
onlineOnlyHelp: Only show things you can do from home. Great if you live far from town or don't have a ride.
remindersHelp: Reminds you 1 week and 1 day before saved deadlines.
languageHelp: The AI will also answer in this language.
installHelp: Add Rumbo to your home screen so it opens like a real app and works offline.
installIos: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen.”
installed: Rumbo is installed on this device.
